evidence_boundary: Known-covariance geometry, scientific calibration and computational scalability are separate evidence. The original n=800 matched study has six independent panels per cell. The 20K workload has one phenotype per scenario and repeated timings, not independent calibration replication. HE and official LDAK fit different covariance workflows; reported h2 values are not interchangeable. HAPNEST simulation-only reaches 100K samples at 12K variants; GWAS reaches 50K samples at 20K variants. Synthetic references do not validate empirical human diversity or upstream Julia equivalence. Research directions remain proposals. The 2.0.0.dev5 comparison has two repetitions per source on simulated panels under unrelated host load; the Lanczos study tests the trace estimator on six panels with one phenotype each. Benchmark reruns reuse official outputs on identical inputs; their cross-program timings span two days.

benchmark_reruns.policy: mixmogam methods rerun with 2.0.0.dev5 on the archived inputs (genotypes verified against export hashes); official LDAK-KVIK outputs, logs and timings reused from the original runs
benchmark_reruns.timing_limitation: Official timings come from 3 October; identical 2.0.0.dev4 code took 33.22 s there and 24.1 s on 4 October for the same 20K fit, so cross-program ratios span host conditions. An unrelated memory-intensive job overlapped the matched, scaling and HAPNEST reruns.
benchmark_reruns.numerical_summary: Exact LOCO reproduces the original matched results; two-step REML paths move by Monte Carlo amounts; the 20K HE arrays are bit-identical to the original run; cached and uncached 20K fits agree exactly; dev4 and dev5 HE p-values are identical on the same day.
